Compact SRAM-only leaf, no hardened-child parent. 60um bins, 8sinks/leaf, <=150um clock segments, isolated SRAM clock leaves; measured leaf arrival balancing 3 rounds. Functional v24 RTL and CP.FETCH cycles unchanged (0.794x/B2 0.828x); exact43case + MUT_WAIT required. Prior v24h CTS FF -91.231 flat15,821buffers, not closed by old v1 historical closure.
